relations: A dark cloud crossing the sun reduces brightness to a diffuse glow, then the sun re-emerges as a smaller disc.
As the sun is hidden and uncovered, the sky shifts between warm golden illumination and cooler muted purple-grey tones.
The cyan lens-flare dot fades when the sun is hidden and faintly returns as the sun's brightness increases.
Upper and side clouds translate and deform slowly, while foreground branches sway slightly with minimal horizon framing shift.
caption: The video captures a low sun sitting right of center in a layered, cloud-filled sky above a dark silhouetted hillside and tree line, with faint distant hills on the right. A long dark horizontal cloud band drifts across the sun, occluding the bright disk until only a diffuse glow remains, then the sun re-emerges as a smaller bright disc before a thin cloud sliver partly covers it again. As the sun is hidden and uncovered, the surrounding sky alternates between warm golden illumination and cooler muted purple-grey tones, while a small cyan lens-flare dot fades and faintly returns with the brightness. Upper and side clouds translate and deform slowly, and the foreground branches sway slightly, the horizon framing shifting only minimally.
